content.comment_body: Hello! I'll try to clarify my setup. I'm building a three-floor elevator system, with sensors on each floor to stop the elevator. My goal is for the project to work using both the physical control box and also remotely through a web page. Currently, the system works well with just the control box, but I'm unsure how to trigger elevator actions from web page button presses. I've attached a screenshot of my program. Could someone provide an example? On the web page, I want three buttons (Button 0 for floor 0, Button 1 for floor 1, Button 2 for floor 2) to control the elevator floors when pressed. Thank you.

Why are you starting a new topic again? I have already responded in your previous thread about what should be connected to the inputs so that clicking activates the project. The answer is already provided there.

Thread closed because the same question was posted twice. The second thread, titled 'What should put on inputs so that when clicking on it, it activates the project?' was published under the [product_name] - Software section. Best regards, [user_name]
